The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewers are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Gourmet Meat]] with [[Goron Spice]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Eating them will restore some [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. Due to their rich aroma and the quality of their [[Meat]]s, these Skewers are considered to be in a league of their own. Additional [[Ingredient]]s can be added to Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewers, which could result in one of the following versions: * '''Chilly Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. * '''Electro Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. If they are eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. These skewers completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. They refill a part of Link's Stamina Wheel when consumed. * '''Hasty Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Link receives a boost to his movement speed when he eats these. * '''Hearty Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Link can eat them to temporarily boost his attack power. * '''Sneaky Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. They increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short while when eaten. * '''Spicy Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] temporarily. * '''Tough Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The rich aroma and juicy texture of this high-quality meat puts it in a league of its own.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients.
